name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Wasauna’s large range of stylish Infrared Saunas are both luxurious and functional. The sauna suits and accessories were manufactured in Arizona and the company prided itself on the superior range of indoor and outdoor infrared saunas.




Wasauna’s indoor and outdoor infrared sauna suits offer you a wealth of health benefits. The Far Infrared technology will help with weight loss as increased heart rate at the optimum temperature will burn more calories. The Near Infrared technology will also help with a range of health benefits from detoxification to improved circulation, both of which will enhance your skin tone through purification.




Wasauna’s infrared saunas are ideal for relaxation. Made from the highest quality hemlock spruce wood, not only is the sauna attractive to the eye it has a divine natural scent which has a calming effect. This, combined with the comfortable seating, soothing lighting and quality CD player make using Wasauna infrared sauna suit perfect for immediately reducing stress and improving wellbeing.
